text:
```yaml
name: Release Please
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release-please:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run Release Please
        uses: google-github-actions/release-please-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          config-file: .github/release-please-manifest.json
```
